GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Race started cloaked in fog, misty rain and gloom. Settled Down Two Wide in the lead by 1 length , went clear and crossed mid-race, led rail by a long neck turning, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened noticeably

Jumped quite well and Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back (4 Lengths leader mid-race) to 8 Lengths rail turning, steered Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in straight. [Stewards: Wanted to lay in throughout. Raced keenly early/middle stage.] # ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Lay in throughout. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Passing the 1000m, after being crossed commenced to over race after improving close to heels. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Settled Down 1 length Two Wide , held together much same to turn 1.25 Lengths Two Wide , Under Pressure rounding turn, Lost Ground in Straight # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near the 500m was bushed and carried wider. Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 2 Lengths , Drifted Back to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it failed to travel throughout and opined it would appreciate a step-up in distance. Post-race vet exam revealed no obvious abnormalities.] # Had Every Chance
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd on fence trailing 1.5 Lengths ,l held together much same to turn 1.75 Lengths Two Wide , kept trying in Straight improving a half length to the line # Had its chances
Jumped well and Went Forward to 2.5 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front, joined 700m, led 3 Lengths jointly turning, Headed 250m and Lost Ground in Straight # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m, steadied to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide at 750m, Drifted Back to 4 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground in Straight # Wide early
Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led same turning, Headed 200m and Lost Ground in Straight # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When under pressure in the straight laid out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, ridden positively & Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths on fence, Held Together in front & led 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed 160m and Lost Ground from there # led/fading 3rd
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: For some distance early, laid in. Lost both hind plates in running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped best and Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by a length, Held Together in front & led rail by 1 length turning, kept going in Straight # led/solid win
Jumped well led from the gate settled down joint leader fence (500m), cornered marginally Clear , headed 100, rallied soundly # pressure/sound
